changelog: A fix for 1.0.77.0, which shipped its main feature inert. The configuration page's schedule edits reach the server as a list, and the property that list arrives in had no setter - so the JSON reader, which cannot fill a collection it has no way to assign, quietly skipped it and handed the server an empty run. Nothing failed: no error, no rejected request, nothing in the log. The server answered every request with the week exactly as it was already stored, so on screen a change appeared and then undid itself a moment later, and Save wrote nothing at all. Moving a programme, removing one, laying the week out again and changing how many weeks a schedule runs for were all affected - which is everything 1.0.77.0 added to the Week screen. The rest of that release was untouched by this and worked. Found by exercising the endpoint against a real server rather than the stub it was built against, because the stub read the request more forgivingly than the server does; five tests now parse a real request body rather than building one in code, which is the only kind of test that could have caught it.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
